items.description:

- IN_TRANSIT - Shipment picked-up/cargo received, depending on the movement type.
- COMPLETED - Shipment delivered / handed over at destination, depending on the movement type.
- CANCELED - Shipment has been canceled
- REJECTED - Booking was rejected

ListParamsDTO.description: This structure contains the filter parameters to limit the response

companyName.description: Company Name is mandatory if the address is not provided via "mdm", "addressId" or based on a myDSV template. (length 36)

addressId.description: Customer addressId refers to an entry in the address book within DSV’s myDSV customer portal. If a unique match is found, that address will be used and all other address fields will be ignored. This validation has lower priority than the "mdm" field. If the addressId is not unique, full address details must be provided. When the provided address matches an existing one, it will be used; otherwise, a new entry will be created in the myDSV address book. (Length: 40)

city.description: City name  is mandatory if the address is not provided via "mdm", "addressId" or based on a myDSV template.

countryCode.description: 2 letter ISO country code (e.g. US)  is mandatory if the address is not provided via "mdm", "addressId" or based on a myDSV template.

zipCode.description: Postal code  is mandatory if the address is not provided via "mdm", "addressId" or based on a myDSV template.

fromDate.description:
The date/time the shipment starts from the Sender / Pickup location. Depending on the main transport mode and the current status of the shipment this is derived from the first matching event in the following sequence: 
Actual Pickup / Trailer arrived at loading location / Actual Departure / Cargo received / Estimated pickup / Requested pickup / Estimated departure / Creation 
format: 2020-07-13T22:00:00

toDate.description:
The date/time the shipment stops at the Receiver / Delivery location. Depending on the main transport mode and the current status of the shipment this is derived from the first matching event in the following sequence:
Actual delivery / Handover responsibility of cargo / Trailer arrived at delivery location / Estimated delivery / Requested delivery / Actual arrival / Estimated arrival
format: 2020-07-13T22:00:00

modeOfTransport.description:
Main mode of transport:
- AIR - Airfreight
- ROAD - Roadfreight
- SEA - Seafreight
- RAIL - Railway
- XPRESS - Express parcel shipments

subModeOfTransport.description:
Sub-mode of shipment transport:
- FSA = First sea then air

status.description:
Overall Booking/Shipment status:

- DRAFT - Booking not yet submitted
- BOOKED - Booking submitted, waiting for response from TMS
- IN_PROGRESS - Shipment created but not yet moving
- IN_TRANSIT - Shipment picked-up/cargo received, depending on the movement type.
- COMPLETED - Shipment delivered / handed over at destination, depending on the movement type.
- CANCELED - Shipment has been canceled
- REJECTED - Booking was rejected

references.description: All references that where used in the booking and/ or shipment to identify linked information. It is possible to receive several references of the same reference type.

bookedBy.description: Name of the user that submitted the booking

incoTermsLocation.description:
Incoterms® Code according to Incoterms® 2020
- EXW = Ex Works
- FCA= Free Carrier
- CPT = Carriage Paid to 'location'
- CIP = Carriage and Insurance paid to 'location'
- DAP = Delivered at Place
- DPU = Delivered at Place Unloaded
- DDP = Delivered Duty Paid
The rules for sea and inland waterway transport only include:
- FAS = Free Alongside Ship
- FOB = Free On Board
- CFR = Cost and Freight
- CPT = Cost Insurance and Freight
Older Incoterms® that may still be used in the message:
- DAF = Delivered at frontier
- DAT = Delivered at terminal
- DES = Delivered ex ship
- DEQ = Delivered ex quay
- DDU = Delivered duty unpaid

fromDateType.description:
The underlying event the "From Date" is based on.
Depending on the main transport mode and the current status of the shipment this is derived from the first matching event in the following sequence:
PCF - Actual Pickup
IGC - Trailer arrived at loading location
DEP - Actual Departure
IRP - Cargo received
ESTIMATED_PICKUP - Estimated pickup
REQUESTED_PICKUP - Requested pickup
ETD - Estimated departure
CREATION - Creation

fromDateStart.description:
The date/time of the event at the location the event took place. 
In case the date type support ranges, this is the earliest date/time
format: 2020-07-13T22:00:00

fromDateEnd.description:
The date/time of the event at the location the event took place. 
In case the date type support ranges, this is the latest date/time
format: 2020-07-13T22:00:00

enum: Empty container picked up at depot - Origin
toDateType.description:
The underlying event the "To Date" is based on.
Depending on the main transport mode and the current status of the shipment this is derived from the first matching event in the following sequence:
DCF - Actual delivery
Z70 - Handover responsibility of cargo
IGD - Trailer arrived at delivery location
ESTIMATED_DELIVERY - Estimated delivery
REQUESTED_DELIVERY - Requested delivery
ARV - Actual arrival
ETA - Estimated arrival

toDateStart.description:
The date/time of the event at the location the event took place. In case the date type support ranges, this is the earliest date/time
format: 2020-07-13T22:00:00

toDateEnd.description:
The date/time of the event at the location the event took place. In case the date type support ranges, this is the latest date/time
format: 2020-07-13T22:00:00

eventGroup.description:
Name of event group:
- Booking - Group for events related to the booking
- Pickup - Group for events related to the pick up for Road shipments
- Pickup / Received - Group for events related to the pick up or received for Air and Sea Shipments
- Main transport - Group for events related to multi-leg shipments
- Import Customs - Group for events related to import customs
- Export customs - Group for events related to import customs
- Delivery - Group for events related to the delivery

eventCode.description:
Event code as provided by the Transport Management System:
- ACT - Set shipment to active
- ATC - Attach to Console
- ARV - Actual arrival (last port/airport)
- BOOKING - Booking
- CANCEL - Cancelled
- CLR - Customs cleared
- DCF - Actual delivery
- DEP - Actual departure (first port/airport)
- DLV - Container delivered
- ESTIMATED_DELIVERY - Estimated delivery
- ESTIMATED_PICKUP - Estimated pickup
- ETA - Estimated arrival (last port/airport)
- ETD - Estimated departure (first port/airport)
- FLO - Freight loaded
- FUL - Freight unloaded
- GIC - Arrived at warehouse
- GIN - Gate In
- GOC - Departure at warehouse
- GOU - Gate Out
- HPD - Held in depot
- IGC - Trailer arrived at collection address
- IGD - Trailer arrived at delivery address
- INA - Set shipment to inactive
- IRP - Cargo received
- NCE - No pickup at customer
- NDE - Not delivered at customer
- OFD - Out for delivery
- PCF - Actual pickup
- PUP - Container picked up
- REQUESTED_DELIVERY - Requested delivery
- REQUESTED_PICKUP - Requested pickup
- Z70 - Handover responsibility of cargo
- Z71 - Customs reported
- Z73 - Handover of cargo
- Z74 - Handover of documents
- RTC - Receipt Commenced
- CAV - Cargo Available
- Z72 - Customs Hold
- DOR - Delivery Order Received
- CCC - Customs Commenced
- DDI (POD) - Document Imported - POD
- DDI (CUI) - Clearance Instructions Received
- ECM - Export Customs Commenced
- ECC - Export Customs Cleared

trackingNumbers.description: SSCC tracking number for the package element.

cargoAircraftOnly.description: Only used for dangerous goods packages, only used for product "Air"

temperatureControlled.description: If the goods required a certain temperature (or temperature range) during transport it will be set to "true"

references.description: References sent along with the booking that can be later on used to identify linked information.

PackageDTO.description: All package details in the booking/shipment.

PackageIdentifierDTO.description: This section contains Package identifier details from  the booking/shipment.

Parties.description: Contains all parties involved in the booking. See the party definition section for more details.

billOfLading.description:
Select the Bill of Lading type.
Only available if product is "Sea".

containerMode.description:
Container mode:
- FCL: full container load
- LCL: less than container load

Only available for product "Sea" and "Rail".

containers.description: This section is only available for the products “Sea” and “Rail” when the Container mode is “FCL”. It is used to specify the required containers of a certain type. Additional attributes can be submitted for certain container types. More details on container types can be found at [link].

dropOff.description:
Pickup mode:
- false = Pickup by DSV, 
- true = Cargo handover to DSV at Warehouse or Terminal

(dropOff becomes mandatory when “dropOff” service is available in Shippers country and product is either “AIR”, “SEA” or “RAIL”)

handover.description:
Delivery mode:
- false = Delivery by DSV
- true = Cargo handover by DSV

(handover becomes mandatory when "handover" service is available in Shippers country and product is either "AIR", "SEA" or "RAIL")

subModeOfTransport.description:
Sub-mode of shipment transport:
- FSA = First sea then air
- FAS = First air then sea

ProductApiDto.description: The product section carries the information about the main transport mode and some directly associated parameters, if any.

Service.description: This section contains additional Service details from the booking/shipment.

ServiceLevelDTO.description: This section contains details on the requested service level from the "Air", "Sea" or "Rail" booking/shipment

bookingId.description: DSV Booking id - Identifier of the Booking

shipmentId.description: DSV Shipment id - Identifier of the shipment

masterShipmentId.description: Identifier of the DSV Shipment master ID

items.description: Identifier of the DSV Shipment child ID

childShipmentIds.description: Identifier of the DSV Shipment child ID

status.description:
Overall Booking/Shipment status:
- DRAFT - Booking not yet submitted
- BOOKED - Booking submitted, waiting for response from TMS
- IN_PROGRESS - Shipment created but not yet moving
- IN_TRANSIT - Shipment picked-up/cargo received, depending on the movement type
- COMPLETED - Shipment delivered / handed over at destination, depending on the movement type
- CANCELED - Shipment has been canceled
- REJECTED - Booking was rejected.

references.description: All references that where used in the booking and/ or shipment to identify linked information. It is possible to receive several references of the same reference type.

bookedBy.description: Name of the user that submitted the booking

packages.description: All package details in the booking/shipment.

issues.description: This section contains Issues details (reasons, dates, descriptions) if ocurred booking/shipment.

publicShipmentId.description: Global Unique Identifier of this shipment (GUID)

carrierTrackingId.description: Tracking ID used by the underlying express carrier

selectedServices.description: Service name, code and detail of the booking/shipment.

houseBillNumber.description: Identification of the Bill of Lading issued by DSV to the customer

masterBillNumber.description: Identification of the Bill of Lading issued by the carrier to DSV

awb.description: Air Waybill Number used by the underlying express carrier

originName.description: Name of the first departure port/airport

originCode.description: UN location code of the first departure port/airport

destinationName.description: Name of the last arrival port/airport

destinationCode.description: UN location code of the last arrival port/airport

scac.description: The Standard Carrier Alpha Code, or SCAC Code, is a two to four-letter code used to identify vessel operating common carriers (VOCC)

TransportApiDto.description: This section carries the information about the main transport and some directly associated parameters applicable for "Air", "Sea", "Rail" shipments.
